text:
anya: anyone on deck to align telemetry scope for Console observability before planning? ACME & Nova asked for cost-per-route + error-sla dashboards. need must-have list for Q3 planning.

devon: I can lead the instrumenting tasks. Quick Q: do we support per-route token attribution yet?

sam: not end-to-end today. backend emits model+route, but token cost calc lives in billing batch. we can approximate with per-request token estimate for MVP.

maria: customer ask: need traces that link user request -> model variant -> GPU pool. they want latency by model variant.

devon: that means adding trace tags: model:*, variant:*, pool_id. should be cheap. can we add prefix KV for routing?

ops-bot: deploy scheduled for staging at 2024-08-14 22:00 UTC — will include trace tag change.

anya: launch criteria proposal: 1) dashboards: cost-per-route (approx), error-rate by route+model, p95 latency by variant. 2) tracing: model/variant/pool tags in spans. 3) oncall alerts for >3% error regressions. thoughts?

sam: :thumbsup: agree but suggest sampling strategy - full traces for errors + 1% for successful requests. otherwise storage cost explodes.

maria: ACME expects daily CSV export of top 10 cost routes. is that in scope for MVP?

anya: MVP: expose a CSV export in console UI for top-10 computed from dashboard metrics (not raw tokens). good stopgap.

devon: action: I'll add trace tags and expose metric names. sam to wire cost estimator. can we target alpha end of sprint (aug 20)?

sam: yes. i'll open PR for estimator today. need config knobs: `trace.sample_rate`, `cost.estimate_window` and a feature flag to disable CSV export.

maria: also request RBAC for CSV export in enterprise. add to acceptance criteria.

anya: noted. final acceptance: docs + migration guide + sample queries. i'll draft acceptance checklist and post before friday.

devon: small ask — add a trace hook for fallback-model events so we can correlate fallbacks -> error spikes.

sam: will add fallback tag and include in sampled error traces. also adding metric: `errors.fallback_rate`.

anya: perfect. i'll capture these as must-have vs stretch: Must: trace tags, dashboards (cost estimate, p95, error by route+model), sampling policy, CSV export UI (dashboard-driven), RBAC for export, alerts. Stretch: raw token join, per-token billing link, 100% trace capture for targeted customers.

maria: thanks — i'll consolidate customer asks and update ACME with proposed MVP scope after your checklist.

ops-bot: reminder: staging deploy window closes 2024-08-21 03:00 UTC.

anya: thanks team — small sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to review PRs and acceptance checklist.
